answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 13408 Country: India Title: If any one see other persons satar (obligatory portion to be hidden (below neval abow knee) , did Vadu of person whoo has seen other person is valied or nullified? Question: If any one see other persons satar (obligatory portion to be hidden (below neval abow knee) , did Vadu of person whoo has seen other person is valied or nullified? Answer ID: 13408 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 900/900=M/1430) Looking at the private parts of other person without a valid reason is unlawful and haram , but only by looking the wudhu will not be invalidated until mazi (fluid) etc is discharged. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
